scope: Pre-publication review of isolated game recovery and Legacy breeding identity candidates; no live state operations

gameRecovery.reviewed: Complete nine-file diff, new recovery inspector, related engine compensation and Mongo resource ports, reported test coverage

findings.finding: The original first-resource failure never created a Cukie binding; requiring both bindings permanently rejects its recovery.
A non-null Cukie reservation is checked as both own and pool; the empty alternative always rejects a valid compensated assignment.
The component forgets the old resume before persisting the replacement; a failed storage write can lose the stable recovery key and trigger random authority creation.
The snapshot includes other sessions using the same credit lots and then blocks recovery if any such reservation is active.
New tests exercise HTTP mapping and session starter, but mock the economic server entrypoint; they do not validate the recovery inspector that authorizes replacement.

gameRecovery.nextStep: Same task corrects GR1-GR5 with canonical server/component regression tests; preserve original commit, no push until root review, full combined gates once after review

legacyBreeding.reviewer: Independent Astra Max, findings reviewed by root

reproduction.result: Observed defective behavior reproduced; not acceptance tests

findings.finding: Mongo ownerNormalized and counters are marked verified without evidence of current ownership/projection coverage.
Imported numChildren=0 overrides two materialized children and incorrectly grants known eligibility.
Selected parents remain in the preview after a wallet change or refreshed evidence revokes eligibility.
A lossy uppercase TRON lookup alias is accepted as verified owner even when the address itself is invalid.

legacyBreeding.nextStep: Same task corrects LB1-LB4 with canonical ownership evidence or fail-closed unknown, reconciled eligibility, contextual preview and valid TRON identity; no push until root review.
